subject: Fix broken CI (#192)
reason: The change modifies only CI infrastructure scripts: ci/build_ubuntu.sh (removes wget --show-progress, affecting only CI log verbosity) and testing/integration/run.sh (pins the valkey-json dependency to a fixed commit and builds it with --release for the integration test harness). No module source code, command handling, indexing, replication or persistence logic is touched, so the built valkey-search module behaves identically at the change and its parent; there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to exercise.
